spec: TRACK 5 — TFLite Micro-compatible architecture alternatives (§2.4, §7). Current: 1D CNN, 18.5KB INT8 quantized, must fit ESP32-S3 flash/latency budget (≤120KB stated ceiling, <100ms inference target, R-01). Research lightweight alternatives evaluated in published fall/HAR (human activity recognition) literature at comparable parameter budgets — TCN, depthwise-separable conv variants, lightweight attention/SE blocks — that report accuracy/sensitivity gains over plain 1D CNN at similar or smaller footprint. Deliverable: comparison table (architecture, reported params/size, reported sensitivity/specificity/AUC if available, TFLite-Micro deployability) and a recommendation on whether swapping is worth it given WP2's Oct 31 deadline, or whether Track 4's training-level techniques are the better time investment.
